figurative_meaning_en: Sweetly coated but sharp or pungent underneath
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথাগুলো খাট্টামিঠা, বাইরে মধুর কিন্তু ভিতরে বিষাক্ত।
এই চিঠিটি খাট্টামিঠা ভাবে লেখা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His words were khattamitha, sweet on the surface but bitter inside.
The letter was written in a khattamitha style, honeyed yet stinging.
note: Refers to words or expressions that appear pleasant but carry a sharp undertone, common in everyday Bengali discourse.
